card.name: The word by after 'removed' before dialysis
card.fires_on: The word "by" right after "removed" (or "removed ... to any degree") in overdose sections, where the next word is dialysis or hemodialysis. It follows statements that a drug is highly protein bound.

modes.label: Removed by dialysis
modes.description: "by" after "removed" in a statement about protein-bound drugs and dialysis.
modes.example: Since esomeprazole is extensively protein bound, it is not expected to be removed<< by>> dialysis.
